description: Injects a non-monotone (direction-changing) relationship into one feature.
business_question: For most number-based columns, {OUTCOME_COL} generally keeps moving in one direction as the column value changes. Which column breaks that simple pattern most clearly? Return only the column name.
ds_question: For each numeric feature, classify its relationship with {OUTCOME_COL} as MONOTONE (consistently increasing or decreasing) or NON-MONOTONE (changes direction at least once). Which feature has the most non-monotone relationship with the outcome? Return only the feature name.
